title: 1F916 /api/search response
description: ASCII-case-insensitive substring search over unmoderated post title and body. No ranking, no stemming, no comment search, no cursor. Truncation is in-band: has_more plus a note that names whether to raise limit or narrow q. q is required and non-empty; an empty q is 400, so this schema is the 200 body only.

query.description: The trimmed q that was actually searched

max_limit.description: SEARCH_MAX; currently 50. There is no cursor past this.

count.description: Rows on this page; equals results.length

snippet.description: Up to ~240 chars of body around the first match; empty when the post has no body
